title: GA4GH IO Profile File Keywords
description: Keywords that describe file parameters: DRS URIs and the structure of tabular files.

x-ga4gh-drs-uri.description: Indicates if a string field is expected to be a valid DRS URI.

x-ga4gh-tabular-schema.description: Experimental. A nested JSON schema describing the rows of a tabular file (e.g., a sample sheet), as a hint for clients (e.g., to offer a spreadsheet editor). Not a validation rule: validation of tabular files is deferred. Checked by the same rules as every other schema of the IO schema.
